acceptance.given: The compiled Toolchain Exact Cover graph contains Atomic Obligations, assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime-evidence nodes.

oracle.expected: Exact-cover validation reports zero orphan nodes and confirms every required node type has bidirectional Exact Cover relationships.
forbidden: Any required node has no exact-cover relationship.
A node is reachable in only one direction.
Validation succeeds while orphan nodes remain.
oracle.observable: The Exact Cover validator's bidirectional graph report, evaluated during compilation or exact-cover validation.

acceptance.then: All required node types participate in bidirectional Exact Cover and none is orphaned.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain compiler builds the obligation graph or exact-cover validation evaluates it.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the planned Exact Cover negative selector with an orphan Atomic Obligation, assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence node and require validation failure.
Run the planned Exact Cover negative selector with a one-directional relationship and require validation failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate bidirectional Exact Cover across Atomic Obligations, assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence, rejecting orphan and one-way graph nodes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore prior Toolchain conformance behavior without changing Phase service state or schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unverified Exact Cover graph becomes a graph checked for bidirectional relationships and orphan absence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The planned selector reports zero orphan nodes across every required node type and fails for an orphan or one-way relationship.

acceptance.given: A frozen non-empty Consumer Manifest and the reconciled repository real-call surface, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers, are available.

oracle.expected: Every applicable Consumer completes enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable through its real call surface; rollback observes the Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category.
forbidden: A manifest entry lacks a reconciled real caller.
Configuration-only switching is accepted as rollback.
oracle.observable: Per-Consumer transition call receipts and the bidirectional Consumer Manifest/call-surface reconciliation.

acceptance.then: All applicable transitions for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry are complete.
acceptance.when: The Consumer transition selector executes against the frozen manifest.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the Consumer transition selector with one applicable real-call-surface transition omitted or unreachable.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconcile the complete non-empty Consumer Manifest bidirectionally with the repository real-call surface, then require each applicable Consumer to execute enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable through its real interface.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Consumer routes and require rollback to reproduce the bound Prior Route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen manifest with applicable transitions pending -> every applicable Consumer has real-call receipts for enable, disable, rollback, and re-enable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selector proves 100% transition completion for the reconciled non-empty manifest and rejects omissions, unreachable consumers, and configuration-only rollback.

acceptance.given: The active Atomic Obligation set and its Exact Cover witness records are supplied to the S12 semantic compilation path.

oracle.expected: Every active Atomic Obligation has a required witness and bidirectional Exact Cover reports zero orphan obligations.
forbidden: A missing witness for any active Atomic Obligation.
An Exact Cover result that accepts an orphan obligation.
oracle.observable: The S12 test assertions inspect the compiled Exact Cover result and its per-obligation witness records, including the negative validator's missing-binding result.

acceptance.then: The compiled result preserves one required witness for each Atomic Obligation and rejects the witness-deficient negative case.
acceptance.when: Exact Cover is compiled or validated

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S12 selector with the exact-cover negative validator's missing reverse binding so the required failure is observed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Compile and assess required per-Atomic-Obligation witnesses through the semantic atomic-recall path; the authored S12 selector asserts full bidirectional coverage and an executable missing-witness red result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting restores the prior semantic witness assessment.

slice_hint.state_transition: Atomic Obligations without independently checked witnesses become a compilation failure instead of an accepted Exact Cover result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S12 selector proves a witness for every active Atomic Obligation, zero orphans, and rejection of the missing-witness negative case.

acceptance.given: Aggregate evaluation receives the complete required Matrix Case/input/subject execution set with one required execution intentionally absent.

oracle.expected: The aggregate evaluation reports failure and identifies the missing required execution; it never returns success for the incomplete set.
forbidden: The aggregate reports success while any required Matrix Case, input, or subject execution is missing.
oracle.observable: Executed aggregate result and its missing-execution diagnostic are captured from the matrix evaluation invocation.

acceptance.then: Execute the aggregate check after removing one required execution from an otherwise complete Matrix Case set.
acceptance.when: Any required Matrix Case execution is missing.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The aggregate accepts an incomplete Matrix Case execution set or omits the missing-execution failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure aggregate evaluation fails closed whenever any required Matrix Case, input, or subject execution is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing aggregate result schema and failure semantics; rollback only the missing-execution guard and its test.

slice_hint.state_transition: complete execution set -> one required execution missing -> aggregate failure with diagnostic
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The aggregate result is non-success and explicitly reports the absent required execution.
